name: the-settings-labels-keep-their-ink
description: the settings page's labels read in their own ink, not the sidebar's glass ink. sidebar.css serves every route, and a block on html once painted the settings labels white on the white window. The reading is the computed colour of the pane's first label on the settings page.

actions.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('label, h1, h2, .row, main, body'); const c = getComputedStyle(el).color; return c === 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)' || c === 'rgb(255, 255, 255)' ? 'white' : 'ink'; })()
actions.note: The sidebar's white glass ink must not reach this page.

assertions.label: settings-opened
assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: the settings page loaded.
The settings labels keep their own ink.
